fusions.name: Carving for the Table
fusions.desc: Carves through every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 26 damage. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Clean the Bone
fusions.desc: Strips a target at or below 30% health for 20 damage, using up every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pare the Spoiled
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Choice Cut
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
